name: Team Wiki
summary: Pages with an owner and a review date, so the team knows what is still true. Starts with Home, Onboarding, How we work and Tools & accounts.
summary_note: The prototype's card says '... and Tools.'; the ticket titles the fourth page 'Tools & accounts', so the card says that (Otto, ticket #1147 ruling 2).
why: Your team keeps answering the same questions, or nobody knows which document is still true.
can: Give every page an owner people can ask
See which pages nobody has checked in 90 days
Send new starters to Onboarding instead of answering in chat
automations: Move stale pages to Needs review

pages.title: Home
must_contain: Search (⌘K, or Ctrl+K on Windows) finds a page by its title.
**Needs review**: someone thinks it's out of date, or nobody has checked it for 90 days. Say why in a comment.

pages.title: Onboarding
must_contain: Welcome. This is the plan for your first week.

pages.title: How we work
must_contain: | Planning | [Mon 10:00, 30 min] | [Everyone] | Agree what we do this week |
| Retro | [every 2 weeks] | [Everyone] | One thing to keep, one to change |

pages.title: Tools & accounts
must_contain: **Never put a password, API key or shared login on this page, or any page.**
